summary: The agent completed a returns disposition audit task successfully, creating both Excel and Word deliverables. The trace reveals a new audit pattern: matching planned dispositions against event logs with alias normalization. Key lessons: (1) Disposition aliases must be normalized for case-insensitive comparison, (2) Missing final events are detected by absence of COMPLETED status for a Return ID + Line ID composite key, (3) The python-docx style API has a common pitfall where paragraph styles cannot be applied to character runs. This extends the existing spreadsheet-audit-reporting skill with a new variant pattern rather than creating a duplicate skill.
